_help: Copy to config.json (gitignored; the install does it). Missing keys take the defaults of cm_core.py, so an old config.json keeps working. Relative paths are relative to this folder.
_engines_help: The crispz family tools that make the keys, through the CLI protocol v1. 'dir' = the install folder, so crispz-motion can start app.py when nothing answers at 'url' (log in logs/<name>.log); 'launch' = allow that start; 'python' = optional interpreter (default <dir>/.venv). An app started by hand is never stopped. One family app at a time on the GPU.
_turbo_help: The spec of every generated key: MOSS-Image with its Turbo LoRA, 4 steps, CFG 1 (Apache 2.0). Needs crispz-moss with per-call guidance and spec LoRAs (commits e250d99, accb7b4).
_work_help: Keys and FILM run at this size at most (megapixels). Bigger outputs go through ESRGAN on every frame.
_esrgan_help: Empty esrgan_dir = the engine's own ESRGAN folder (crispz-moss preferences.json, else <dir>/upscale_models).
